claims.statement: A reference ending with the Spring Data Repository setting suffix (default Repository) triggers a repository creation suggestion.
claims.supports: ends with the value specified in the Spring Data Repository settings, default Repository

claims.statement: A reference ending with a Projection suffix (defaults Info, Prj, Projection, VO, Vo, View, Request, Browse) triggers a projection suggestion.
A reference ending with the DTO suffix (default Dto) triggers a DTO suggestion.
After accepting a suggestion the corresponding wizard opens.
